hero.title: Inspired by Nature
hero.body: A gallery art exhibition hosted by Sheboygan Senior Community. We're inviting artists of all ages and abilities to share work — no jury, no experience required.
hero.imageAlt: A framed artwork on display in the Sheboygan Senior Community gallery space

intro.title: Show us nature as you see it
paragraphs: We're inviting artists of all ages and abilities to share work for our upcoming gallery exhibition, Inspired by Nature. We invite artists to interpret this theme in their own way.
Whether your inspiration comes from a favorite hiking trail, native plants, changing seasons, natural materials, or the colors and patterns found in nature, we'd love to see your perspective.

theme.title: Theme
theme.body: Nature surrounds us in countless forms — from sweeping landscapes and quiet woodlands to blooming gardens, winding shorelines, mushrooms, and wildlife. Interpret this theme in your own way. All artistic mediums are welcome.
inspiration: Abstract patterns and colors inspired by nature
Memories of a favorite place in nature
theme.examplesTitle: Some examples of what your artwork could be inspired by
examples: Photographs or paintings of mountain ranges, bodies of water, volcanos, sunsets.
Sculptures made of natural materials like stone, clay, and wood.
Kinetic sculptures that move with airflow, such as mobiles or fabric installations.

guidelines.title: Submission guidelines
items: Artists may submit up to two pieces of artwork for consideration.
Please submit your original artwork no later than September 16, 2026.
All artwork must be original and ready for display.
A brief artist statement highlighting the connection to the exhibition theme.
The price of your artwork, if you wish to sell it.

dropoff.title: Submission period
dropoff.body: Bring your work to the gallery during any of the windows below. Need a different time? Email Melissa and we'll arrange it.
options: Email a photo of your completed artwork to Melissa Thiel.
Arrange a drop-off time for your completed artwork with Melissa.
Send your completed artwork via mail to the gallery address.

display.title: Artwork display details
display.body: The exhibit will be open to SSC residents, staff, families, and the wider community — creating a shared space for connection, reflection, and creativity.
